### Bug type

Behavior bug (incorrect output/state without crash)

### Beta release blocker

No

### Summary

In OpenClaw 2026.9.9 with @openclaw/codex 2026.9.9, settled-turn context capture repeatedly fails with `invalid_content` in a Telegram session containing a legitimate image-only user message stored with empty text and no upstream-text fallback.

### Steps to reproduce

### Observed production sequence

1. Run OpenClaw 2026.9.9 with @openclaw/codex 2026.9.9 using the Codex app-server harness and SQLite session storage.
2. Use a long-lived Telegram direct-message session.
3. Send a JPEG-only Telegram message without accompanying text.
4. Observe that the resulting historical user event is stored with `content: ""`, JPEG media metadata, and no `upstreamUserText` fallback.
5. Continue the conversation with Codex until a later turn completes via a terminal dynamic tool result.
6. Observe successful Telegram outbound delivery.
7. Observe a subsequent `session context snapshot read` followed by `codex settled-turn finalization context capture failed reason=invalid_content`.

### Actual incident chronology

All times are UTC+03:00, October 15, 2026.

- 10:03:01 — JPEG-only Telegram message received.
- 10:03:04 — A corresponding historical user event is persisted.
- 10:05:24 — A later Codex turn successfully delivers a Telegram response and is released after a terminal dynamic tool result.
- 10:05:41 — Context snapshot processing completes after approximately 16.9 seconds.
- 10:05:41 — Finalization context capture fails with `invalid_content`, followed by `context_unavailable`.

The audit correlated the next relevant mirrored user prompt with the same failing run/turn.

### Proposed isolated reproduction (not yet executed)

1. Create a valid historical media-only user message with empty string content and properly structured JPEG media metadata.
2. Place the message before a later settled Codex turn containing valid mirrored prompt and tool-call/result evidence.
3. Run the settled-history projection in an isolated test environment.
4. Check whether the earlier media-only message causes `CodexHistoryRejection("invalid_content")`.

This is a proposed regression test, not a claim of an independently executed minimal reproduction.

### Expected behavior

A legitimate, verified historical media-only user message should not invalidate settled-turn finalization solely because its text field is empty.

If historical media cannot be represented in the text-oriented recovery projection, Codex should use a safe, explicit representation indicating that historical media content is unavailable.

The original canonical transcript, event identities, media metadata, and provenance requirements must remain unchanged.

Arbitrary malformed empty messages without valid media metadata must still be rejected. Current-turn tool-result completeness and provenance checks must remain strict.

### Actual behavior

The installed Codex history projector contains a validation path equivalent to:

```javascript
const upstreamUserText = readUpstreamUserText(message);

const text = upstreamUserText
  ? requireBoundedText(
      upstreamUserText,
      projection,
      MAX_PROJECTION_BYTES
    )
  : requireBoundedText(message.content, projection);
```

When `message.content === ""` and no usable upstream-text fallback exists, `requireBoundedText()` throws:

`CodexHistoryRejection("invalid_content")`

The observed historical message matches these conditions.

The settled-history projection also validates earlier messages before trimming the previous conversation to its final bounded output. Consequently, an incompatible historical message may repeatedly reject later finalization attempts.

The affected installation logged recurring `invalid_content` failures from October 15 through October 26.

There were 401 such failures in the Gateway-wide journal during that period. These counts are not all independently attributed to the same session.

The documented outgoing Telegram responses were delivered successfully before the finalization errors.

### OpenClaw version

2026.9.9

### Operating system

Ubuntu 24.04.5 LTS

### Install method

npm global

### Model

NOT_ENOUGH_INFO

### Provider / routing chain

OpenClaw Gateway -> @openclaw/codex 2026.9.9 -> Codex app-server -> OpenAI

### Additional provider/model setup details

The Codex plugin was installed as an OpenClaw-managed npm generation.

The independent audit confirmed that the canonical installed-plugin registry selected the inspected Codex package generation. The running Gateway also reported the Codex plugin loaded.

Direct in-memory module-generation attestation was not performed.

No plugin files, configuration, authentication state, or runtime parameters were changed during the investigation.

### Logs

```shell
Sanitized representative sequence from October 15, 2026:

[telegram] outbound send ok operation=sendMessage deliveryKind=text

[agent/embedded] codex app-server turn released after terminal dynamic tool result

[sqlite/transaction] slow SQLite transaction hold operation="session context snapshot read" elapsedMs=16900 isMainThread=false

[agent/embedded] codex settled-turn finalization context capture failed reason=invalid_content

[agent/embedded] codex settled-turn finalization context is unavailable reason=context_unavailable

[auto-reply/message-tool-outcome] recorded message-tool-only run outcome

All account, conversation, thread, run, and message identifiers have been omitted from these logs.

There was no observed persistent `SESSION_WORK_START_CHANGED` or `DispatchSessionRefreshRequiredError` deadlock in the correlated runs.
```

### Screenshots, recordings, and evidence

### Sanitized structural evidence

A targeted, read-only inspection of the historical event established:

| Property | Observed value |
|---|---|
| Event type | `message` |
| Message role | `user` |
| `content` | Empty string (`""`) |
| `upstreamUserText` | Absent |
| `excludeFromContext` | Absent |
| Media metadata | One JPEG image |
| Image layout metadata | Present |
| Mirror identity | Absent on this historical event |
| Active transcript | Yes |
| Context eligible | Yes |
| Created | October 15, 2026, 10:03:04 local |

A subsequent mirrored user event carried the matching prompt identity and run ID for the first observed failing turn.

The latest indexed reset boundary preceded the suspicious event. No later reset or compaction boundary was identified in the indexed history.

### Minimal illustrative message structure

The following is synthetic structural evidence, NOT a complete executable reproduction fixture:

```javascript
const historicalMessage = {
  role: "user",
  content: "",
  __openclaw: {
    media: [
      {
        kind: "image",
        contentType: "image/jpeg"
      }
    ],
    mediaImageLayout: {}
  }
};

// No upstreamUserText.
// No excludeFromContext.
// Real fixtures must include valid canonical media metadata.
```

### Relevant source locations

Inspected implementation:

- `extensions/codex/src/app-server/settled-turn-projection.ts`
  - `projectUserMessage()`
  - `requireBoundedText()`
  - `SettledTurnPriorContext.append()`
  - `verifiedSettledMessages()`

- `extensions/codex/src/app-server/session-history-read.ts`
  - `readCodexNativeHistory()`
  - `sanitizeCodexHistoryImagePayloads()`

- `extensions/codex/src/app-server/settled-turn-context.ts`
  - `captureCodexSettledTurnFinalizationContext()`

- `src/config/sessions/session-accessor.sqlite-model-context.ts`
  - `withTranscriptContextSnapshot()`
  - `readSessionTranscriptContextMessages()`

- Session context iterator:
  - `projectSessionEntryMessage()`
  - `iterateSessionContextMessages()`

The context iterator ordinarily preserves the historical user message unless a semantic boundary or explicit context exclusion applies.

The specific media-only historical event is currently active, context-eligible, and not excluded.

### Verification limitations

The stored event representation and validator's conditional rejection behavior were independently established.

A live trace identifying the exact first rejected record was not performed.

A minimal regression test against the latest development branch was not executed.

The original transcript and database were preserved unchanged.

### Impact and severity

Affected: OpenClaw installations using the Codex app-server harness with historical media-only messages in their session context.

Severity: Significant reliability degradation of settled-turn finalization. The documented message delivery succeeded, but finalization context capture failed repeatedly.

Frequency: Recurrent on the investigated long-lived Telegram session. The Gateway-wide journal recorded 401 `invalid_content` failures between October 15 and October 26, though not all have been individually attributed to this session.

Consequences:

- Failure to capture verified settled-turn recovery context.
- Additional expensive session-history reads after completed responses.
- Repeated errors on later turns that may traverse the same historical message.
- Possible loss of the normal finalization/recovery behavior, without evidence that the already delivered Telegram messages failed.

No SQLite corruption or persistent session-admission deadlock was demonstrated.

### Additional information

### Related issues

- #184289 — Similar `invalid_content` finalization symptom, but with an additional queued-inbound/session-admission deadlock that was not observed in this case.
- #181084 — Separate large-session SQLite navigation and performance problem.

### Why this is a distinct bug

This report focuses on a concrete incompatibility between legitimate historical media-only user-message representation and Codex's text-oriented settled-history projection.

It does not claim that the entire large-session performance problem, earlier pairing failures, or the session-admission problem in #184289 have the same root cause.

### Requested correction

Please consider handling authenticated, legitimate historical media-only user messages explicitly during Codex recovery-context projection.

A possible design is to represent unavailable historical media with a deterministic, clearly labeled omission placeholder while keeping the original canonical event and evidence metadata unchanged.

Regression coverage should include:

1. Legitimate historical image-only messages.
2. Image-only messages with usable upstream-text fallback.
3. Empty messages without valid media metadata.
4. Invalid media metadata.
5. Tool-call/result pairing failures.
6. Mirror identity and provenance mismatches.
7. Prior-history trimming.
8. Current-turn evidence completeness.

The validator should not broadly ignore malformed messages or weaken security/provenance requirements.

### Preservation requirements

The original historical events, SQLite databases, media metadata, memories, and conversation history should not need to be deleted or rewritten to correct this compatibility problem.

The forensic investigation was strictly read-only. No repair, compaction, session reset, plugin modification, or upgrade was performed.

I can provide further sanitized structural evidence if maintainers need it. Raw user conversations, databases, images, credentials, and private diagnostic archives cannot be uploaded publicly.

Thank you for investigating this.

comments.body:
Codex review: this still needs some work.

**Summary**
Keep open: current main rejects an intentionally valid persisted media-only user message before prior-history trimming, preventing Codex recovery-context capture.

Reproducibility: Current source establishes a deterministic path: eligible prior media-only content remains empty, reaches projectUserMessage, and throws invalid_content before trimming; this is source proof, not an executed reproduction.

**Next step**
Fix prior-history projection for valid media-only messages and first establish a failing regression through verified settled-history capture.


<details>
<summary>Review details</summary>

Best possible solution:

Represent valid prior media-only messages explicitly in recovery context without rewriting canonical history or weakening current-turn evidence checks.

Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue?

Current source establishes a deterministic path: eligible prior media-only content remains empty, reaches projectUserMessage, and throws invalid_content before trimming; this is source proof, not an executed reproduction.

Is this the best way to solve the issue?

A narrow prior-history representation is appropriate because empty canonical text is intentional; changing stored messages or accepting arbitrary empty content would violate existing contracts.

AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant.

Remaining risk / open question:

- The reporter's exact first rejected record and the attribution of all 401 journal failures remain unverified.
- No current-main runtime reproduction was executed during this read-only review.

Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [fbc0e8c61c60](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fbc0e8c61c607b7db88e6cb2332495d93ffa8c48).

</details>

<details>
<summary>Label changes</summary>

Label changes:

- add `P2`: A source-proven compatibility defect repeatedly disables recovery-context capture, while the report confirms successful Telegram delivery and demonstrates no persistent admission stall.
- add `impact:session-state`: Valid persisted conversation history prevents capture of the verified settled-turn context used for final-answer recovery.
- add `issue-rating: 🦞 diamond lobster`: Current issue advisory state selects this label.
- add `clawsweeper:source-repro`: Current issue advisory state selects this label.
- add `clawsweeper:queueable-fix`: Current issue advisory state selects this label.
- add `clawsweeper:fix-shape-clear`: Current issue advisory state selects this label.

Label justifications:

- `P2`: A source-proven compatibility defect repeatedly disables recovery-context capture, while the report confirms successful Telegram delivery and demonstrates no persistent admission stall.
- `impact:session-state`: Valid persisted conversation history prevents capture of the verified settled-turn context used for final-answer recovery.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Evidence reviewed</summary>

Acceptance criteria:

- Before opening a PR, demonstrate the new verified-history regression fails on the pinned base with invalid_content and passes with the repair.
- pnpm exec vitest run extensions/codex/src/app-server/settled-turn-prior-context.test.ts extensions/codex/src/app-server/settled-turn-projection.test.ts extensions/codex/src/app-server/settled-turn-context.test.ts
- pnpm exec vitest run extensions/codex/src/app-server/settled-turn-finalizer.native.test.ts
- Run touched-file typecheck, lint, formatting checks, and git diff --check.
- Exercise an isolated Gateway with real Codex and Telegram image-only history; verify later settled-turn capture succeeds, canonical events remain unchanged, and completed actions are not replayed.

What I checked:

- **Current rejection path:** projectUserMessage passes empty string content without upstreamUserText to requireBoundedText, which throws invalid_content without consulting persisted media metadata. ([`extensions/codex/src/app-server/settled-turn-projection.ts:85`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/fbc0e8c61c607b7db88e6cb2332495d93ffa8c48/extensions/codex/src/app-server/settled-turn-projection.ts#L85), [fbc0e8c61c60](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fbc0e8c61c607b7db88e6cb2332495d93ffa8c48))
- **Prior history reaches the validator:** verifiedSettledMessages appends history preceding the current anchor to SettledTurnPriorContext; append validates each message before bounded suffix selection can omit it. ([`extensions/codex/src/app-server/settled-turn-evidence.ts:102`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/fbc0e8c61c607b7db88e6cb2332495d93ffa8c48/extensions/codex/src/app-server/settled-turn-evidence.ts#L102), [fbc0e8c61c60](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fbc0e8c61c607b7db88e6cb2332495d93ffa8c48))
- **Canonical empty-text storage contract:** buildPersistedUserTurnMessage intentionally persists params.text or an empty string alongside media metadata; the session iterator returns eligible message records without adding text. ([`src/sessions/user-turn-transcript.message.ts:220`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/fbc0e8c61c607b7db88e6cb2332495d93ffa8c48/src/sessions/user-turn-transcript.message.ts#L220), [fbc0e8c61c60](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fbc0e8c61c607b7db88e6cb2332495d93ffa8c48))
- **Existing boundary behavior and regression contract:** The ordinary LLM boundary injects media-only text without changing persisted facts, with coverage explicitly asserting that persisted.content remains empty; Codex native-history consumption only sanitizes image payloads. ([`src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/attempt.llm-boundary.test.ts:189`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/fbc0e8c61c607b7db88e6cb2332495d93ffa8c48/src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/attempt.llm-boundary.test.ts#L189), [fbc0e8c61c60](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fbc0e8c61c607b7db88e6cb2332495d93ffa8c48))
- **Intentional storage design:** Merged https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/111204 deliberately removed persisted media-only placeholders so clients display bare user content, placing decoration at the model boundary. ([`src/sessions/user-turn-transcript.message.ts:223`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/1d1565245d7d911dac1cb657d671b4fa6f38a9c0/src/sessions/user-turn-transcript.message.ts#L223), [1d1565245d7d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1d1565245d7d911dac1cb657d671b4fa6f38a9c0))
- **Recent repair addresses a different condition:** Merged https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181718 handles unfinished earlier tool exchanges at prependTo; the empty-message rejection still occurs earlier during append. ([`extensions/codex/src/app-server/settled-turn-projection.ts:412`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/c12e36d64d31eed6e2d4bdda6c0f1ac80b4a0761/extensions/codex/src/app-server/settled-turn-projection.ts#L412), [c12e36d64d31](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c12e36d64d31eed6e2d4bdda6c0f1ac80b4a0761))

Likely related people:

- **Hosung Park:** Raw commit c12e36d64d31eed6e2d4bdda6c0f1ac80b4a0761 adds extensions/codex/src/app-server/settled-turn-projection.ts:412 relative to its recorded parents. This identifies author metadata, not feature responsibility or a PR merger. (role: source-line author; confidence: high; commits: [c12e36d64d31](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c12e36d64d31eed6e2d4bdda6c0f1ac80b4a0761); files: `extensions/codex/src/app-server/settled-turn-projection.ts`)

</details>

<details>
<summary>How this review workflow works</summary>

- ClawSweeper keeps one durable marker-backed review comment per issue or PR.
- Re-runs edit this comment so the latest verdict, findings, and automation markers stay together instead of adding duplicate bot comments.
- A fresh review can be triggered by eligible `@clawsweeper re-review` comments, exact-item GitHub events, scheduled/background review runs, or manual workflow dispatch.
- PR/issue authors and users with repository write access can comment `@clawsweeper re-review` or `@clawsweeper re-run` on an open PR or issue to request a fresh review only.
- Maintainers can also comment `@clawsweeper review` to request a fresh review only.
- Fresh-review commands do not start repair, autofix, rebase, CI repair, or automerge; those execution lanes are retired.
- Maintainers can comment `@clawsweeper explain` to ask for more context, or `@clawsweeper stop` to stop active automation.

</details>
